facts.text: The block on hand edits comes from the auto-run extension, config/pi/extensions/auto-run.ts, which refuses edit and write tool calls.
facts.hit: Manual edit/write tool calls are refused by the auto-run guard in config/pi/extensions/auto-run.ts.

facts.text: The edit block is active while an AUTO.md file exists at the root of the checkout.
facts.hit: An AUTO.md at the checkout root activates the hand-edit guard.

facts.text: The block on git worktree add inside the repo also comes from auto-run.ts, which refuses a bash command whose worktree target is inside the repo.
facts.hit: auto-run.ts rejects bash calls adding a git worktree at a path within the repository.

facts.text: A scout --rw worker is not affected because scout starts its child pi with extensions disabled (-ne), so auto-run.ts is not loaded there.
facts.hit: scout --rw bypasses the edit guard by launching child pi with -ne, leaving auto-run.ts unloaded.

decoys: scout --fork starts the child from a copy of the parent session, which re-bills the whole parent context.
scout exits with code 124 when its timeout expires.
scout --ctx keeps AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md discovery in the child, which is off by default.
